rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone speaks or behaves in a stern, serious manner.

example.english: They spoke austerely to me, saying this matter could not be delayed any longer.
example.traditional: 佢嚴肅咁同我講，呢件事唔可以再拖。
